DRAFT, Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident (for Mateo Quiroga's procurement team). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 2026.

First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected; scheduling from the dispatch office was not.

Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch saw it.

Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for the vendor's reconnect attempts. Carrowmere Cloud is checking the Hartford gateway route.

Open items: status-page access for procurement is still being worked (ticket INC-4821). Monitoring continues through another arrival cycle.
